en: Changed OpenTelemetry `tool_input` to show only the length of text sent through SendUserMessage or Cowork's message tool, unless response logging is on (`OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1`)
zh: OpenTelemetry `tool_input` 现在仅显示通过 SendUserMessage 或 Cowork 的消息工具发送的文本长度，除非开启响应日志（`OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1`）
